- Do you support PEPPOL/EDIFACT or any ERP integrations (we use Oracle Cloud)?
- What fields are included on your invoice (VAT breakdown, Redwood tax ID, remittance address)?

Subject: Re: Request: e-invoicing & payment setup with Redwood Inference

Hi Liam — thanks for the PO and the clear list. Happy to get this set up. Summary of options and our ask below: 

1) Delivery options
- Preferred: Redwood Console/Portal e-invoicing (we can push invoices and provide a monthly consolidated statement). Portal invites create a canonical copy and reduce missed emails.
- Alternate: PDF invoices delivered to an AP mailbox (we can send to accounts-payable@acmecorp.com and copy a secondary billing email).

2) Formats & integrations
- We support PDF and CSV export for ERP ingestion today. We also support SFTP pulls and can work with a partner connector for PEPPOL/Oracle Cloud (requires an onboarding form).

3) Payment methods
- SEPA (EUR), ACH (US), wire; card is available for small invoices. Remittance instructions are included on the invoice.

4) VAT / tax fields we include
- Invoice subtotal, VAT amount (per line), total, Redwood tax ID, remittance address, invoice number and PO reference.

What we need from you to finish onboarding:
- Confirm preferred delivery (portal or email + cc address)
- Billing contact name and preferred billing email (for billing-specific questions)
- Company VAT ID and remittance address (if applicable)
- Whether you want consolidated monthly invoicing (yes/no)

If you pick the portal, I'll send an invite to your billing contact and provide integration paperwork if you want SFTP/ERP. If email only, please confirm the canonical AP mailbox and if you want the portal copy turned off.

I can start portal invite and attach our onboarding form to collect integration details. For visibility I looped in Marissa (sales lead) and Sean (finance ops) to approve any special terms (e.g., consolidated billing cadence or non-standard remittance).

Cheers,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

phone: +1 415-555-0134

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: FW: Request: e-invoicing & payment setup with Redwood Inference

Neha / Sean — forwarding Acme's request. Quick thoughts: 

- Recommend portal onboarding as default for enterprise customers (reduces manual handling and future AP escalations).
- Offer consolidated monthly invoices with line-level PO references; that keeps ledger tidy for them and reduces ticket volume for us.
- For VAT: Acme is EU-headquartered but US ops — ask for their GB/ EU VAT ID and the billing country to determine whether VAT is applied. If they provide EU VAT and are B2B with a valid ID, we zero-rate per current rules.
- Terms: default net-30 but happy to consider net-45 only if procurement signs a revenue ops-approved amendment. No need for discount here.

Action: Neha — send portal invite to billing contact once they confirm. Sean — can you prepare a one-page summary showing the effect of consolidated monthly billing on invoice count and expected payment timing? I'll include it in the mutual action plan.

Marissa
Sr. Account Executive
Redwood Inference
